summary: Shoshone County lookout site: camp in 1919, L-4 cab in 1935 with a crow's nest on Mulligan Hump, destroyed 1954; the FFLA list marks it gone.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Gone; both pages date destruction to 1954; no source describes what remains

events.note: L-4 cab; the crow's nest stood two miles east atop Mulligan Hump

evidence.quote: 1919: camp. 1935: L-4 cab. Crows nest 2 miles east atop Mulligan Hump. Destroyed 1954.

evidence.supports: crow's nest two miles east atop Mulligan Hump
evidence.quote: Crow’s nest 2 miles east atop Mulligan
We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

notes_for_editor: Only two lookout pages and the FFLA list; the 1935 cab and 1954 destruction both appear on the two lookout pages (Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com); no independent corroboration beyond those pages was found. Searches did not find a Mulligan Hump lookout elsewhere. Unverified lead, not used in the story: a search summary described a UIdaho aerial photo captioned 'Buzzard Roost lookout', St. Joe NF, dated 1961; the link I tried returned 404 and I could not open the item, so it may conflict with the 1954 date and should be checked. A Clearwater NF list (https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/259185) has a Mulligan Hump cabin (1930s, ruins, 3930 ft, Sec13 T42N R6E), probably a different peak; not linked. The elevation (4871 ft) is in the source but not recorded in facts. Drive-up is the Idaho FL label and describes road access only.
